instruction: I want quick desktop access to this website. Could you add it to my desktop using the browser's shortcut tool?

metadata.explanation: Task variation for creating a desktop shortcut for Netflix using Chrome's shortcut feature. Same pattern as original task - single website, single action to create desktop shortcut. The app-id for Netflix is hcbdgflppmkacnlcnmkeahepfdlfdahg. Uses existing evaluator functions.

Metric (is_shortcut_on_desktop) with type 'exec' correctly checks for the exact Exec command in shortcut file contents
Expected exec command '/opt/google/chrome/google-chrome --profile-directory=Default --app-id=hcbdgflppmkacnlcnmkeahepfdlfdahg' is semantically correct for Netflix (app-id confirmed in metadata)
The evaluator fully verifies the single instruction requirement: creating a desktop shortcut for the website (Netflix) using Chrome's shortcut tool
Data flow is correct: getter extracts shortcut files -> metric checks for expected exec command -> verification succeeds if shortcut exists with correct command
The verification logic will work correctly at runtime - standard .desktop file format on Linux is well-defined
